caseName: Watts v. Arizona ex rel. Burgoon
caseNameFull: Cornelius C. Watts v. State of Arizona at Relation, etc., of Ignatius Burgoon, Treasurer, etc.

opinions.text: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Arizona. November 15, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari herein denied. Mr. Herbert Noble and Mr. Joseph W. Bailey, for plaintiffs in error, in support of the petition. Mr. Leslie C. Hardy, for defendant in error, in opposition to the petition.
